source.paper: R. A. Wilson, Classification of subgroups isomorphic to PSL_2(27) in the Monster, LMS J. Comput. Math. 17 (2014), Sec. 4.1-4.2
source.commutator_convention: [x,y]=x^-1 y^-1 x y; the opposite convention fails Wilson's centralization identities

relation_to_stored_canonical_V2.interpretation: E and stored V2 are complementary maximal totally singular, type-4-free orbit-7 generators with perfect pairing

stored_V2_dual_scalar.construction: S_V=P^-1 S_E^-T P from the perfect E--V2 pairing

theorem: Wilson's explicit A4 x G2(4) subgroup in the stored mod-2 Co1 representation fixes the concrete good generator E=Fix(V4). E is 12-dimensional, totally singular and type-4-free. The A4 order-3 generator is literally F4 scalar multiplication, while the G2(4) generators become explicit 6x6 F4 matrices. The order-13 generator has a degree-6 irreducible F4 factor of Phi13. E and the stored canonical V2 are complementary, perfectly paired orbit-7 generators, which canonically induces an explicit dual F4 scalar on stored V2.
boundary: All matrix, singularity, type-4, field-factor and pairing statements are exact computations. An explicit Co1 conjugating word E->stored V2 is not yet constructed, and Co1 membership of the pairing-dual scalar on stored V2 is not asserted.
